SELECT
  cs.id AS campsite_id,
  cg.id AS campground_id,
  cg.name AS campground_name,
  cs.name,
  cs.loop_name,
  cs.kind,
  cs.kind_listed,
  cs.max_people,
  cs.max_cars,
  cs.max_rv_length,
  cs.max_trailer_length,
  cs.electric_hookups,
  cs.water_hookups,
  cs.sewer_hookups,
  cs.ada_accessible,
  cs.pull_through,
  cs.equipment,
  cs.price,
  cs.schedule,
  vr.vendor,
  vr.external_id AS vendor_ref_id,
  cs.source_payload,
  cs.updated_at,
  cs.deleted_at
FROM campsites cs
JOIN campgrounds cg ON cg.id = cs.campground_id
LEFT JOIN campsite_vendor_refs cvr ON cvr.campsite_id = cs.id
LEFT JOIN vendor_refs vr ON vr.id = cvr.vendor_ref_id
WHERE COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND cs.id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '');

SELECT sibling.id AS campsite_id, sibling.loop_name, sibling.name, sibling.kind, sibling.max_people, sibling.updated_at
FROM campsites selected
JOIN campsites sibling ON sibling.campground_id = selected.campground_id AND sibling.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND selected.id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
ORDER BY sibling.loop_name NULLS LAST, sibling.name NULLS LAST;

SELECT
  s.id AS snapshot_id,
  s.campsite_id,
  s.run_id,
  s.target_date,
  s.status::text AS status,
  (s.status = 'available') AS available,
  s.last_observed_at,
  lag(s.last_observed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.campsite_id, s.target_date ORDER BY s.last_observed_at, s.id) AS observed_from
FROM availability s
WHERE COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND s.campsite_id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
ORDER BY s.last_observed_at DESC, s.id DESC
LIMIT 500;

SELECT
  s.last_observed_at AS time,
  s.target_date::text AS metric,
  CASE s.status::text
    WHEN 'available' THEN 4
    WHEN 'first_come' THEN 3
    WHEN 'reserved' THEN 2
    WHEN 'booked' THEN 1
    WHEN 'closed' THEN 0
    ELSE -1
  END::double precision AS value
FROM availability s
WHERE COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND s.campsite_id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
ORDER BY s.target_date ASC, s.last_observed_at ASC;

SELECT w.id, w.status, w.start_date, w.end_date, w.cadence_sec, w.trigger_kinds, w.stop_when_triggered, w.campsite_filters, w.created_at
FROM availability_watch w
JOIN availability_watch_target wt ON wt.watch_id = w.id
WHERE COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND wt.campsite_id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
ORDER BY w.created_at DESC;

list.definition:
SELECT __text, __value
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS sort_key, 'No campsite selected' AS __text, '__no_campsite' AS __value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_key,
    cs.id::text || ' | ' || cg.name || ' / ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.loop_name, '') || ' / ', '') || cs.name || ' | ' || cs.data_source AS __text,
    cs.id::text AS __value
  FROM campsites cs
  JOIN campgrounds cg ON cg.id = cs.campground_id
  WHERE cs.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (
      '$__searchFilter' = '%'
      OR cs.id::text ILIKE '$__searchFilter'
      OR cg.name ILIKE '$__searchFilter'
      OR cs.name ILIKE '$__searchFilter'
      OR cs.loop_name ILIKE '$__searchFilter'
      OR cs.data_source ILIKE '$__searchFilter'
    )
) options
ORDER BY sort_key, __text
LIMIT 1001
